newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND'S BROOKE SUSPENDED FOR TWO WEEKS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND'S BROOKE SUSPENDED FOR TWO WEEKS.

text.p: Auckland Blues and All Black lock Robin Brooke was suspended for two weeks on Monday for a late charge in the Blues' Super 12 match against Canterbury Crusaders on Friday.

A New Zealand Rugby Football Union judicial hearing upheld the citing of an illegal tackle against Brooke, but accepted he had not acted maliciously in shoulder-charging Canterbury fullback Leon MacDonald several metres away from the ball.
The incident occurred four minutes from halftime and sidelined MacDonald for the rest of the match which Auckland, the reigning Super 12 champions, won 29-28.
The ban means Brooke will miss two crucial top-of-the-table matches for third-placed Auckland, against the ACT Brumbies on Saturday and against the Gauteng Lions (formerly Transvaal) on April 19.
